prompt:
Extract a SysML v2 model from the document as a list of facts. Each fact has unit_id (the sentence it comes from), type and slots. Give only the slots that have a value, as a list of {slot, value} pairs; for composition give one 'parts' pair per part.

Types and slots:
  attribute(owner,name,value,unit) action(performer,label) state(owner,label) constraint(subject,expression) requirement(subject,text)
  composition(whole,parts) flow(source,target,payload) succession(before,after) transition(from,to,trigger) allocation(action,to)

Name each element by its full name as first introduced in the document.
RULES:
- Resolve every entity-valued slot using all the text you are given. If a sentence refers to an element by an alias, abbreviation, pronoun or shorter description, write the element's full name as first introduced. If a sentence says an element receives or uses an item and the text you are given states which element produces or sends that item, emit a flow from that producer to the receiver. If an element cannot be determined from the text you are given, use null; never guess.
- Never write placeholder words such as "any", "all", "some state" for an unstated element; use null.
- Do not merge differently named things unless the text says they are the same.
- Emit one action for EVERY behavior verb phrase, including passive voice (performer null), capability statements, displays, logs, generates and reports. label = the verbatim verb phrase with its object.
- Emit a requirement for every NORMATIVE statement (shall, must, should, will, is required to, needs to). Purpose, goal or benefit sentences are not requirements.
- Emit a state for every named mode or state; transitions use the state names, with from null when the prior state is not stated.
- Emit a succession only for an EXPLICIT temporal connective between two actions ("then", "after", "once", "before", "when ... is complete", "next", "finally"); before/after are the action labels. Never use succession for cause or data transfer.
- Resolve a pronoun or "this/these" performer to the element named in the preceding sentence and write that element's name; if it cannot be resolved, use null. Never output a pronoun as a slot value.
- Drop determiners and quantifiers from element names ("Each Soil Moisture Probe" -> "Soil Moisture Probe", "the system" -> "system").
- allocation.to must be a component or actor, never a mode or state.
- Emit a constraint for every threshold, limit, period or deadline stated with a number; expression = the verbatim phrase.
- Emit a flow for every sentence in which an element sends, transmits, reports, displays, commands or delivers an item (target null if the receiver is not named).
 Also list under "entities" every system element, actor or item named in the document units, with its full name and any alias the text explicitly declares for it (e.g. 'hereafter X', 'known as X', 'called X'); aliases [] if none. Return JSON {"entities": [...], "facts": [...]}.

Memory from EARLIER parts of the document (do not extract facts from it; use it only to resolve names, aliases and who produces an item):
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System advises; incident command retains authority; no autonomous dispatch/equipment control. Confirmed Ignition State requires observations/procedures; recognize Airspace Restricted State and safety pauses.

Actors: Duty Detection Officer (Orion), County Emergency Liaison, Air Attack Supervisor, Tanker Base Manager, Helitack Crew Leader, Drone Pilot Operator; local fire agencies, county emergency management, state wildland fire resources, aviation support units, cooperating public safety partners.

Elements/items:
• Caldera Incident Command Portal (Emberhall): command interface; displays imagery/history/weather/maps/advice/status; opens human-review triage above screening threshold.
• North Lookout Camera Mast sends Thermal Spot Snippet after candidate-heat identification; South Lookout Camera Mast provides complementary coverage. Licensed-wireless video; cellular degraded backup where available.
• Horizon Ridge Drone Dock (Kestrel): launch/recovery/charging/shelter; maintenance controller produces Battery Swap Ticket at replacement threshold.
• Drone Tasking Service prepares approved, constrained verification tasks when fixed views are obscured; no flight-release authority. Drone Pilot Operator reviews route/dock/constraints before procedural coordination.
• Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine (Lantern): receives observations; normalizes image/thermal/weather into common event records; traceable advisory recommendations.
• Smoke Classifier Module supplies confidence; produces Ridge Shadow Mask against terrain-shadow inflation.
• MesoWest Weather Fusion Node (Brindle): quality-checked observations/forecasts; wind/humidity/temperature/stability context; sends Wind Shift Bulletin under configured rules.
• VHF Radio Gateway Repeater: monitored radio/workstation bridge; policy-controlled recording/access; broadband-loss continuity.
• Crewline Mobile Tablet gives Helitack Crew Leader approved incident/maps/updates.
• Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console gives Air Attack Supervisor/Tanker Base Manager aircraft/loading/mission data; East Retardant Loading Pump and West Retardant Loading Pump expose readiness/faults to authorized staff.

Mandatory infrastructure: segmentation, synchronized time, health checks, audit logs. Camera/dock observations require timestamps/georeferences/equipment status. Assess smoke texture/persistence/motion/contrast; thermal supports unless persistent or smoke-aligned. Scores≠fire declarations. Orion compares frames/growth/drift/disappearance; may request pan/tilt/zoom; authorized acceptance/rejection/verification follows. Retain timing/source/model/acknowledgment traceability.

Document units:
S063: The Drone Pilot Operator confirms that the proposed verification task is safe for launch conditions and consistent with current operating constraints.
S064: The VHF Radio Gateway Repeater supports voice coordination when field observers or aviation personnel can provide independent confirmation from their location.
S065: The Air Attack Supervisor may be referred to by the alias Redtail during radio coordination, but the operational record uses Air Attack Supervisor.
S066: The Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console may be referred to by the alias Marigold during dispatch coordination, but the operational record uses Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console.
S067: Confirmation requires at least one persistent smoke indication or thermal cue, plus either independent sensor corroboration, field report corroboration, or a direct human visual judgment recorded by an authorized reviewer.
S068: A suspected ignition remains in triage when evidence is inconsistent, stale, or limited to a single low-confidence source.
S069: The Caldera Incident Command Portal records the reason for each triage decision so later operators can understand whether the case was advanced, held, or dismissed.
S070: When the confirmation rule is satisfied, the incident record is advanced to the Confirmed Ignition State and becomes available for suppression planning.
S071: The Confirmed Ignition State includes the best known location, confidence basis, observation history, reviewer identity, and current recommended coordination posture.
S072: Crewline Mobile Tablet users receive only the confirmed incident context that has been released for field distribution by the command workflow.
S073: East Retardant Loading Pump sends the Retardant Batch Slip after a load cycle is metered and sealed.
S074: If air operations are constrained, the Caldera Incident Command Portal can associate the incident with the Airspace Restricted State before aircraft tasking is attempted.
S075: Dismissed cases remain searchable for audit and model improvement, but they do not create a suppression assignment or public incident notification.
S076: This section defines how the Caldera Incident Command Portal supports coordinated air and ground operations after an incident enters a managed response posture.
S077: When the Caldera Incident Command Portal shows the Airspace Restricted State, aircraft tasking is treated as conditional until the Air Attack Supervisor confirms the active operating window.
S078: The Duty Detection Officer records the restriction basis in the Caldera Incident Command Portal so later decisions can be traced to the operational condition in effect at the time.
